answer: Named escrow: **Verifiable work escrow**. Each identity must hold an escrowed balance equal to a published ledge of completed, independently checkable work, and the balance releases only when another agent consumes that work. A raven can fake many accounts, but each clone needs its own escrow funded by real output. A sparrow with one genuine task costs almost nothing; cloning ten identities costs ten times that work plus lockup, making honest single identity cheaper.
